The first Super Artemis release: Artemis with microphone streaming, a menu and controls you set up yourself, smarter sessions, safer backups and a batch of proven fixes from upstream Moonlight and other forks.

**Install:** `SuperArtemis-v1.0.0-arm64-v8a.apk` installs as `com.mohitarora.superartemis`, next to Artemis and Moonlight. Pair it with Apollo once, since each app has its own pairing identity. You can also follow updates with [Obtainium](https://github.com/Arora-Sir/Super-Artemis#super-artemis).

## What's new

### Voice
- Microphone streaming to Apollo (`stream_mic = enabled` on the host).
- "Microphone at stream start": always off (default), always on or follow last state, remembered per PC.
- Mute and unmute from the menu or the quick-action bar. Muting powers the microphone down, so the privacy indicator turns off.

### Menus and controls
- Quick Menu in sections: your actions, Disconnect and Quit in red, then Advanced Menu, Customize menu and Cancel. The Advanced Menu has Back to Quick Menu.
- Menu editor with list, grid and compact styles picked next to a live preview.
- Quick-action bars: pinned actions and keys as small buttons in any screen corners, each corner a row or a column with its own buttons. Toggles show green while on, and the bars fade when idle.
- Special keys: hide, reorder or re-icon the built-in keys, and record your own shortcuts on the built-in keyboard or a physical one, with names and 75 icons.
- Configurable 3, 4 and 5-finger taps and double taps and 3 and 4-finger swipes, in every touch mode including pan and zoom. Gestures set to Nothing reach the PC, and one tap sets the Windows touchpad swipes.
- The built-in keyboard lets go of held keys when it closes (an option, on by default).

### Sessions
- When you leave the stream: disconnect, resume the same app when you come back within 30 minutes, or keep it in picture-in-picture, which now also starts on a quick app switch.
- Optional "Connect to the last PC on app start".
- Network drop grace period, so short Wi-Fi drops do not end the session.

### Backup, look and about
- Backup of every setting to one `.sabackup` file you save or share, with an optional password and pairing keys as an explicit opt-in. Restore lets you pick what to restore and warns about settings the new device cannot use.
- A modern look: rounded centered dialogs, a search bar that stays on screen and finds everyday words, regrouped settings with a section list on tablets, and an optional Material You style on Android 12 and later chosen from live previews.
- Settings > About: support development (UPI card with QR, PayPal), developer links and in-app credits with a link for every contribution.

## Fixes
- Frame pacing is honoured again instead of being forced to Balanced, a renderer loop that dropped about half the frames is gone, and drop thresholds follow refresh rate changes (Samsung reports in ClassicOldSong/moonlight-android#416, #415 and #376).
- The forced surface frame rate and size that caused stutter are removed.
- Decoder setup can no longer hang on NVIDIA or MediaTek decoders, and the audio effects setting is no longer tied to "Play audio on PC".
- Android cloud and device transfer backups no longer copy the pairing private key, and the exported poster provider only serves its own cache.
- Joy-Con fix setting, needless 4K display mode switches, Print Screen and the Samsung keyboard cover screenshot key, crashes with out-of-range vendor key codes, and `art://` pairing on slow networks.
- Controller LED crashes, rumble on newer Android, Xbox Series controller IDs, Shift for the plus key and Android 15 and 16 key codes, from Moonlight 12.2.
- Native core: better recovery after video loss, RTT queries without locking, thread leak fixes and RTSP hardening.
- A three-finger tap in trackpad mode no longer fires a middle click and the keyboard at once. Turning off Back Menu no longer disables the five-finger menu tap or the floating menu button, and gestures work in pan and zoom mode.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Arora-Sir/Super-Artemis/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md).
